# Strict second reading of the fill review, version 0.2

*Generated by `scripts/strict.mjs` from `audit/strict/sample-0_2.json`, `audit/strict/reading-0_2.js`, `audit/strict/sweep-0_2.js` and `audit/fill-review-0_1.js`. Do not edit by hand.*

Rule [ruling: operator, 2026-11-13]: Strict [ruling: operator, 2026-11-13]: confirmed only when a quoted window states the field's claim itself, not merely names the object or operation; a claim of several parts is confirmed only if every part is quoted, otherwise imprecise or unsupported, saying which part is missing.

The review's grades (`audit/fill-review-0_1.js`) stand as they were; this reading sits beside them. Where a field has a strict grade, the strict grade is its effective grade under the strict rule.

## The blind sample

Seed 20261113 (mulberry32, as scripts/audit.mjs), drawn 2026-11-13 before any grade was read. Frame: Every field of audit/fill-review-0_1.js (436 entries) graded confirmed, unsupported or imprecise, less D7-001, D7-002, D7-003, D7-004, whose grades the reader saw before the draw. Strata by the review's verdict: confirmed 100 of 1935, unsupported 30 of 641, imprecise 15 of 15 (20 asked; the stratum is taken whole). Each stratum shuffled (Fisher-Yates) and its first n taken, strata in the order confirmed, unsupported, imprecise; a stratum smaller than its n is taken whole (a census); the draw then shuffled together and numbered. The stratum of an item is not written here; it is recomputed from the review at comparison time.

Reader: A second session of the same model family, blind to the review's grades, quotes and notes for the sampled fields. Independence: Blind to the review's verdicts for every sampled field (D7-001 to D7-004, seen before the draw, are out of the frame); same model family as the first grader, and the excerpt files it reads were windowed by the first grader, so errors may be correlated.

### Agreement matrix

Rows: the review's verdict. Columns: the strict reading's, from the excerpt files the review named. 145 of 145 items graded.

| Review \ strict | confirmed | imprecise | wrong | unsupported | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed | 62 | 32 | 0 | 6 | 100 |
| imprecise | 0 | 14 | 1 | 0 | 15 |
| unsupported | 1 | 3 | 0 | 26 | 30 |
| total | 63 | 49 | 1 | 32 | 145 |

Exact agreement: 102 of 145.

### Confirmed that the strict rule does not confirm

Of the review's confirmed fields in the sample (a simple random draw from the 1935 confirmed fields of the frame), the strict reading confirms fewer. Flip rate: 38/100 = 38.0% (95% Wilson interval 29.1% to 47.8%). Batches 1 to 5: 11/33 = 33.3% (95% Wilson interval 19.8% to 50.4%). Batches 6 to 18: 27/67 = 40.3% (95% Wilson interval 29.4% to 52.3%).

Where the flips go: imprecise 32, wrong 0, unsupported 6.

Other strata: of 30 unsupported, the strict reading finds 4 settled by the named files; of 15 imprecise, it confirms 0.

### Why the confirmed fields flip

Each disagreement's cause, written after unblinding: **part**, a window states some of the claim and a part is in no window; **names**, the windows name the object, operation or an ingredient (or carry the claim only in a cut fragment or a cross-reference label) and state none of it; **detail**, a window states a detail otherwise; **reads**, the strict reader reads a window as stating what the review did not.

Of the 38 flipped confirmed fields: detail 3, names 14, part 21. Of them, 11 carried a note in the review naming a part no source settled or a source that differs.
